label: MacBook Air 13-inch (M2, 2022)
description: Fanless 13.6-inch ultraportable with the Apple M2 SoC (2022); two Thunderbolt/USB 4 ports, Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0 only.
notes: No Ethernet at all: no RJ45 and no onboard NIC. The only native uplink is Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax); wired needs a USB-C dock or a 1GbE/2.5GbE dongle. Include it to model hosts that cannot be cabled without extra hardware.
